features.name: Anello Alta Velocità (Sopraelevata)
features.notes: OSM raceway ways named Sopraelevata Nord/Sud, Rettilineo anello alta velocità, and Anello alta velocità, stitched by endpoints. Not closed: OSM does not map the west high-speed-ring lane (historically beside the pit straight), leaving a ~664 m gap between the mapped Nord and Sud west ends. Mapped ribbon ~3594 m vs published 4250 m ring. Width 12 m (1955 five-strip section 1.75+1.95+2.25+2.70+3.35 m) and 80% max banking from monzanet.it / the Beri–Di Renzo section. GP underpass under the north bank is track landmark oval-north-underpass at s=3298. West-straight gap is an OSM omission — not filled from aerial.
